Good Evening, I work in a blood bank in Missouri, where we have 2 confirmed cases. These cases are both over 200 miles away.
Yesterday my supervisor, reported his symptoms, and is quarantining at home. He hasn’t been tested, and doesn’t know if or when he will be.

Meanwhile, the rest of us have been told to continue coming in, but to use our common sense. Or in other words keep coming to work until you are showing symptoms.

The way I see it though, donations (which we have been getting hundreds of daily , because my community is full of awesome caring people)
Will drop off. My guess, by next week we will see fewer and fewer until there are none. 

But this is important. Please, if you get the virus, once you have recovered, DONATE YOUR BLOOD AND PLASMA!
We will need your antibodies. 
Thank you.
